boards.title: Join your circle
boards.note: Home, private online play, supported SIM selection and the unavailable-device state.
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished FINAL v2 mobile product design board for the app "Tambola Circle" (exact spelling). This replaces earlier Trust Tambola concepts. Brand palette deep plum #290435, violet #76207d, warm gold #efd080, ivory #fffaf2 paper, dark ink. Clear modern SANS-SERIF typography throughout, warm family game personality, subtle rounded cards, crisp flat product UI, minimum decorative clutter. Landscape high-resolution board: EXACTLY FOUR equally sized tall Android APP ARTBOARDS side by side with four narrow even gutters, each about390x844 ratio. Simple thin rounded borders, pale lilac board background, short board heading at top and numbered screen captions immediately above each artboard. No angled devices. All in-app text legible and concise. IMPORTANT: NO Android status bar, NO clock9:41, NO battery/signal icons, NO bottom navigation buttons or gesture pill, NO iPhone notch/Dynamic Island. Screens fill the entire device rectangle. Show only application UI. No Trust branding, no recovery codes, no editable phone fields, no freehand pen/eraser/drawing toolbar. This is a finished design handoff image, not actual implemented software. Reserve most vertical space for ticket strips whenever tickets are shown. Use clean purple circular outlines around individual marked numbers; there is no freehand drawing.
Board title "TAMBOLA CIRCLE / 01 — Join your circle".
01 "Home": full plum background, refined circular gold group-of-friends logo and large two-line brand Tambola Circle. One small ticket illustration; copy "Your people. Your game." Prominent gold "Play online". Outlined "Offline caller". Compact secondary actions "My tables", "Settings", "Account". Small "Friends & family, wherever you are." Plenty of breathing room without enormous illustration.
02 "Online mode": header Tambola Circle. A welcome chip "Priya". Private table card selected, subtitle "Invite your friends and family"; Public table disabled "Coming soon". Gold "Create private table", outlined "Join with table code". Compact active-table card "Sunday Family · Round 3" with "Rejoin". Link "Game history".
03 "Select your SIM": header "Join Tambola Circle"; labelled editable Name field "Priya" is allowed. Text "Choose a number from your device". Device selection list two radio rows labelled "Detected number 1" "+91 ••••••4321" selected, and "Detected number 2" "+91 ••••••7654". These are masked illustrative device values, NOT input boxes; small native-picker icon. A line "SIM selected · Device sign-in"; no Verified label. Link "Choose another SIM" invokes device picker. Disclosure tickbox "Share my name and number with table members". Gold "Continue". No SMS, typed phone entry or recovery links. Board caption footnote outside screen "SIM selection when supported; native chooser may vary."
04 "SIM selection unavailable": header Tambola Circle. Simple SIM icon; title "SIM selection isn't available". Body "This device couldn't provide a selectable number." Informational card "Online registration is unavailable on this device for now." Actions outlined "Try again" and gold "Use offline caller". Quiet "Your table invite is saved". No manual number entry or other unapproved authentication fallback.
